basic_info.description: 231 Roosevelt Way offers a unique opportunity to own a meticulously maintained three-unit Victorian residence in the heart of San Francisco's coveted Corona Heights neighborhood.     This charming building includes a two-bedroom/two-bathroom flat, a cozy one-bedroom on ground level with garden views, and a well appointed upper-level one-bedroom unit with access to a deck with lovely views. All units are currently tenant-occupied, making it an excellent investment opportunity. There is also potential for future owner-occupancy in the recently partially remodeled 2BD/2BA flat.     The middle 2BD/2BA flat features abundant natural light, breathtaking city and water views, stainless steel appliances, and beautiful hardwood flooring.The open and inviting living room flows seamlessly into a separate dining area, perfect for entertaining. This unit is further enhanced by two generously sized bedrooms, two remodeled bathrooms in 2022, and a delightful deck that offers a serene retreat.     Additional features of this property include a spacious two-car garage, shared laundry, ample storage space, and a lushly landscaped garden an ideal space to unwind and escape the city's hustle and bustle.
